controller_relationship: Separate reasoning agents under the same operator; not independent economic counterparties.
deliverable: Public evidence schema and acceptance checklist for the three authorized existing-pool live mechanics cases.

payment.asset: Circle testUSDC on Base Sepolia (chain ID 84532)
payment.condition: Explicit buyer acceptance identifying exact deliverable SHA256 digests; executor must separately pass existing funding and transaction preflight gates.
payment.funding: Existing authorized spare 1 testUSDC inside the total reused 7 testUSDC experiment allocation; no additional spending authority.
payment.classification: Internal experiment transfer of test currency with no economic value; not independent customer revenue or human income.
payment.execution_status: Not paid; no buyer transaction or signed transaction exists.

capital_policy.reason: Producing this evidence specification has no demonstrated incremental upfront cash cost. Do not create artificial borrowing need to satisfy a narrative.
capital_policy.mechanics_case_distinction: The authorized loan-to-controlled-input-sink cycle is a separate mechanics experiment; any task payment may occur only if compatible with its already approved ledger and unwind.

acceptance_requirements: Identify the authorized deployed pool, chain and contract/source/runtime provenance without asserting that PR28 is deployed.
Require fresh block identifiers, parameter reads, full initial source/commitment ledger and custody classification; preserve original root-custodied funds and obligations separately.
Record exact public transaction hashes, receipts, status, block linkage, sender/recipient, decoded economic effects and before/after per-address and pool state.
Use integer base units; reconcile exact aggregate testUSDC before and after every case, while accounting ETH gas separately.
Require full debt/backing/stake/shares/allowance cleanup and preservation of unrelated pool balances, assets, reserve, dues and credit before admitting the next case.
Encode the 7 testUSDC and 0.003 testETH cumulative-run caps, available unwind funding and first-day repayment deadline/abort policy.
Cover all three cases and distinguish actual repayment, peer aid and compelled colluder cleanup from revenue, defaults or voluntary honesty.
Require exact read-only refusal calldata/state/block/results and distinguish intended protocol refusal from irrelevant access-control, RPC or invalid-call failure.
Clearly distinguish actual agent work/decisions, single-controller on-chain mechanics, unproven independent demand, and unproven poverty alleviation.
Include a machine-readable usable schema, understandable checklist and reproducible SHA256 digests; do not publish private keys, credentials or signed bytes.
rejection_policy: Request concrete revisions for repairable evidence omissions. Reject unsupported live-execution or economic-success claims. A complete evidence template can be accepted as a service without accepting a future live run.
limitations: This order does not authorize deployment, mainnet expenditure, faucet access, minting, new credentials, access-control bypass or changes to the original approved live plan.
